items.summary: Disclosure: I'm at Boson AI and this is our release. Not open weights; the Duplex API has a waitlist, and the previous turn-based Higgs Realtime is available now. Most voice models are still turn-based: listen, wait for end of turn, think, speak. Duplex runs all streams at once and keeps working in the background while it talks. Streams. Everything is cut into 160 ms chunks:  Audio in: 1 token per chunk (6.25 tokens/s) Audio out: 2 tokens per chunk (12.5 tokens/s) Video in: one ~12-token camera

items.headline: Ueno Bank scandal plunges Paraguay into political crisis

confirmed_facts.text: Ueno Bank scandal plunges Paraguay into political crisis November 6, 2026 The Ueno Bank collapse is turning into one of the biggest financial and political scandals in the history of Paraguay.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Ueno Bank scandal plunges Paraguay into political crisis November 6, 2026 The Ueno Bank collapse is turning into one of the biggest financial and political scandals in the history of Paraguay.

confirmed_facts.text: At issue are suspected banking irregularities, hundreds of millions of dollars in public funds, and business ties between the bank and the country's president, Santiago Pena.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: At issue are suspected banking irregularities, hundreds of millions of dollars in public funds, and business ties between the bank and the country's president, Santiago Pena.

confirmed_facts.text: The crisis was triggered on November 3, when the Paraguayan central bank (BCP) initiated resolution procedures against Ueno after determining that it had breached minimum solvency requirements.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The crisis was triggered on November 3, when the Paraguayan central bank (BCP) initiated resolution procedures against Ueno after determining that it had breached minimum solvency requirements.

confirmed_facts.text: The public prosecutor has since announced three investigations into suspected financial crimes.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The public prosecutor has since announced three investigations into suspected financial crimes.

confirmed_facts.text: On November 5, he tendered his resignation, but the Paraguayan Congress did not accept it.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: On November 5, he tendered his resignation, but the Paraguayan Congress did not accept it.

confirmed_facts.text: Instead, the Chamber of Deputies voted unanimously to impeach him.

items.headline: ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted

confirmed_facts.text: The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.

confirmed_facts.text: Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994.

confirmed_facts.text: The final results are expected to be announced on Sunday.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The final results are expected to be announced on Sunday.

confirmed_facts.text: The ANC was on 31.8% of the vote nationally, almost 14 percentage points below its 2021 local election result.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The ANC was on 31.8% of the vote nationally, almost 14 percentage points below its 2021 local election result.

confirmed_facts.text: The centre-right, white-led Democratic Alliance (DA) had 24.1% of the vote, while the uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) party of the former ANC president Jacob Zuma was on 9.3%.
